resources.string: Shows the next prayer countdown while active. For an always-on 24/7 countdown, add Siraj\'s Lock Screen widget.
iOS plays up to 30 seconds of the selected adhan on the lock screen; tap the alert to hear the full adhan.
Long-press your Home Screen or Lock Screen, tap Edit → Add Widget, and choose Siraj. Tap any placed widget to pick its face and palette.
The 604-page Mushaf, recitation, Listen Hub, Khatma, and video export arrive in the next update.
The live compass and Qibla finder arrive in the daily tools update.
Hisn al-Muslim adhkar, Tasbih, Hadith, 99 Names, Quran Radio, Fasting, and Zakat arrive in the daily tools update.
Always-on offline countdown to the next prayer.
Updates your Home Screen icon and the emblem across Siraj.
